```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Americans are the most generous people in the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No nation spends more in combined public and private efforts to combat disease and poverty around the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No nation works harder to ensure the continued vitality of the global economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A world where half of the human race lives on a few dollars a day is neither just nor stable.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Including the world's poor in an expanding circle of development is part of the Republican approach to world trade through open markets and fair competition.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Including the world's poor in an expanding circle of development must be a top priority of Republican foreign policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Decades of massive aid have failed to spur economic growth in the poorest countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Decades of massive aid has often propped up failed policies and corrupt rulers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Foreign assistance will be targeted to fostering the rule of law through democratic government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Foreign assistance will be targeted to emphasizing literacy and learning.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Foreign assistance will be targeted to clean water, agricultural improvement, and microcredit funding for small enterprises.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Maternal and child health, especially safer child-birthing and nutrition, must be priorities, especially in countries affected by epidemics of HIV/AIDS, malaria, and tuberculosis.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
